text.en:
Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 1281 is hereby amended to read, as follows:
"Sec. 2. The name "Bureau of Mines" is hereby changed to "Bureau of Mines and Geo-Sciences", and shall be
headed by a Director and an Assistant Director, both of whom shall be appointed by the President.
"No person shall be appointed Director or Assistant Director of the Bureau of Mines and Geo- Sciences unless
he is a natural-born citizen of the Philippines, at least 30 years of age, and shall be of recognized competence,
particularly in the fields of mining engineering, geology, geodetic engineering, metallurgy, management, law,
economics, or any field related to the development of mineral resources."

Section 3 of Presidential Decree No. 1281 is hereby amended by changing paragraph (s) thereof
and by adding paragraphs (t) and (u) and as changed and added to read, as follows:
"Sec. 3. The Bureau of Mines and Geo-Sciences shall have the following functions and powers, to wit:
"s.) To require mining lessees/operators to include in their annual program of work submitted to the Bureau of
Mines and Geo- Sciences for the approval of the Director of Mines and Geo-Sciences the extent of the
research and development projects to be undertaken by them on their mining claims and to monitor the
implementation thereof to the Bureau of Mines and Geo-Sciences;
"t.) To require mining permittees, lessees or operators to submit to the Bureau of Mines and Geo-Sciences
samples of their mineral products together with a complete analysis of the same; and
"u.) To grant, or recommend to the Minister of Natural Resources the granting of, the right to undertake the
installation and operation of milling or processing plants to produce ores and/or mineral products."

Section 4 of Presidential Decree No. 1281 is hereby amended to read, as follows:
"Sec. 4. For an efficient and effective implementation of its powers and functions, the Bureau of Mines and
Geo-Sciences shall be composed of ten (10) Divisions, as follows:
1. Administrative Services
2. Budget and Fiscal

3. Accounting
4. Geological survey
5. Mineral Economics and Information
6. Metallurgical and Laboratory Services
7. Mining Technology
8. Mineral Lands and Topographic Survey
9. Marine Mineral Resources
10. Mineral Resources Administration
"Existing divisions may be organized, merged or abolished, and additional divisions, sections and units may
be established and new positions therefor created by the Minister of Natural Resources, upon the
recommendation of the Director of Mines Geo-Sciences, as may be necessary to exercise powers and
discharge the functions of the Bureau of Mines and Geo-Sciences under this Decree. In addition to the
existing Planning and Management Staff, positions requiring highly technical skills and expertise may be
created under the Office of the Director of Mines and Geo-Sciences as the exigency of the service may
"The existing mining regions with offices at Baguio City, Metro-Manila, Daet, Cebu City and Surigao City
shall be maintained, and shall conform to the national regionalization numbering scheme. Upon the
recommendation of the Director of Mines and Geo-Sciences, the Minister of Natural Resources may establish
other mining regions as the need for them arises, the boundaries of which shall so far practicable coincide with
the boundaries of the corresponding provinces: Provided, however, That mineral districts may be established
by the Minister of Natural Resources in existing mining regions, subject to such rules and regulations that
shall be promulgated by him."

The phrase "Bureau of Mines" found in Presidential Decree No. 1281 is hereby changed to "Bureau
of Mines and Geo-Sciences."
The word "Secretary" as used in Presidential Decree No. 1281 is hereby changed to "Minister".

The phrase "Director of Mines" as used in Presidential Decree No. 1281 is hereby changed to
"Director of Mines and Geo-Sciences".

All laws executive orders, decrees, rules and regulations or parts thereof contrary or inconsistent
with this Decree are hereby amended or modified accordingly.
This Decree shall take effect immediately upon promulgation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
